proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxies used by the Actor -- the same object the platform's proxy editor produces. Either Apify Proxy ({"useApifyProxy": true} with optional "apifyProxyGroups" and "apifyProxyCountry"; needs APIFY_PROXY_PASSWORD, see the runtime README) or your own servers ({"useApifyProxy": false, "proxyUrls": ["http://user:pass@host:port"]}).

targetUrl.sectionDescription: Optionally prove the resolved proxy works by fetching a page through it.
targetUrl.title: Target URL
targetUrl.description: URL to fetch through the resolved proxy (leave empty to skip the request; the Actor then only resolves and reports the proxy configuration). https://api.apify.com/v2/browser-info echoes the IP the request came from, so it shows the proxy's IP instead of yours.
